drawings.description: sous les chaînes, deux croquis de segments gradués parcourus par des flèches vers la gauche, un petit parallélogramme marqué d'un point, et un « $A$ » isolé
drawings.kind: graduated segments with leftward arrows; small parallelogram with a point; isolated A
drawings.notes: Redrawn on tight crops; the figure bboxes are recomputed (the earlier ones did not match the page). (1) Under the chain x_1 <= x_2 ... <= x: three slanted graduation strokes crossed by a long leftward arrow, with a point; this is read as the first graduated segment of the transcription (the short strokes between it and the chain are left out as part of the text). (2) Upper right: a segment between two points, a tick at its middle, a curved arrow running back to the left point. (3) The row of leftward arrows under [phi_0 -> ... -> phi_n] (one thin, one heavy, and a faint one higher up under Sigma 1_{phi,p}); this was the earlier reading of the second sketch and is kept, the formulas and the brace under it are text. (4) A small parallelogram with a stroke across it and a point (next to the A). (5) The isolated A. (6) Lower left: a larger curved quadrilateral, open at its upper right corner, with an inner arc ending on its right side and carrying a point, and a small cross stroke at its lower right corner. Still a reading: the transcription names one parallelogram marked with a point, and the page has two such small figures, (4) and (6); which strokes make its two graduated segments. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, deux croquis : un secteur coupé de deux arcs, et une figure portant « $X_{1} \neq \emptyset$ », « $X = \emptyset$ » et une accolade marquée $\alpha_{p}$ (?). Au bas, raturé et entrelacé de traits, un reste de suite « $\ldots \to W \to W/N \to \ldots$ », et en marge droite, écrit en long, « \uncertain{cf.} \ill{} V.A.\ \ill{} Lang ».
drawings.kind: sector cut by two arcs; figure with X_1 != empty, X = empty
drawings.notes: Redrawn on tight crops, the struck lines of the page left out (the long oblique stroke crossing the page, the two long horizontal strokes through the text, the struck sequence at the bottom, the struck letters at the lower left). (1) At the lower left, the sketch read as the sector: a top edge, a curved left side, a lower right edge and a right side, a long diagonal from the upper right ending on the heavy stroke, which runs from the left side to the right side; every junction is computed once. (2) Upper centre: an outlined figure with a pointed lower corner (curved left side, straight lower right edge doubled by two pencil strokes, a short upper right edge), crossed by a heavy arc from a point on its left side up to the right, with two short strokes above it; the labels inside and to the right are read empty = X and empty != 'X (a short upright stroke before the X, which may be the subscript 1 of the transcription's X_1 written before the letter). The brace alpha_p of the transcription is not found and is left out. Still a reading: which of the two sketches is the 'sector cut by two arcs' (the arcs are not clear on either). Disagreement: the transcription places the sketches 'a droite'; on the render they are in the left half of p. 107. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription places these sketches "a droite"; on the render they are at the left of p. 107 (the only figure at the right is a narrow upright ellipse at the top).

drawings.description: schéma encadré : à gauche $\mathbb{G}_m$, $\mathbb{G}_a$ soulignés ; deux traits en éventail en partent. Sur le trait supérieur : $\mathbb{Z}/\ell\mathbb{Z}$, puis $\mu_p$, $\alpha_p$, $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ ; sur le trait inférieur : $\mu_p$, $\alpha_p$, $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$, puis $\mathbb{Z}/\ell\mathbb{Z}$ ; les deux convergent vers $\mathbb{V}$ et $\mathbb{Z}$ (lettres doublées) soulignés, à droite. Le schéma met face à face, dans l'ordre inverse, les groupes que la page 192 énumère
drawings.kind: framed schema: two fans of groups from G_m, G_a to V, Z
drawings.notes: In a frame: G_m, G_a underlined at the left; two strokes fanning out; on the upper stroke Z/lZ, then mu_p, alpha_p, Z/pZ; on the lower stroke mu_p, alpha_p, Z/pZ, then Z/lZ; both converge to V and Z (doubled letters) underlined at the right. Two long strokes crossing the frame (crossing out the page) are drawn grey.
